name: Mountains and Waters Zen Community
reason: Mainly activist work (flagged): the SZBA entry links an old WordPress site (vairochanafarm.wordpress.com, read 13 Nov 2026) whose last post (2018) points to mountainsandwatersalliance.org. That site's stated mission (read 13 Nov 2026) is to heal the climate emergency through 'farming as activism' and defending land and water, with pipeline-protest and election posts; the Zen group is a small part of Shodo Spring's alliance and farm near Faribault, Minnesota. Possible future individual listing for Shodo Spring (dharma heir of Shohaku Okumura; author) if the owner wants it.
